tips.text: Poke with Piercing Arrow from long range, and hold the charge a moment for more damage. Fire it quickly when the enemy is close.
Auto the enemy to build Blight stacks, then hit them with an ability to detonate the stacks for extra damage and shorter cooldowns.
Take an early point in Blighted Quiver to poke harder and finish off minions.
Use Hail of Arrows on the spot where the enemy is trying to fight or run. The area leaves them slowed and weakens their healing.
Varus is slowed while he charges Piercing Arrow, so don't charge it with an enemy right on top of you.
Aim Chain of Corruption at the first enemy to leave them rooted. It spreads to nearby enemy champions, so it shines in team fights.
Take kills and assists to power up Living Vengeance, then keep fighting while the bonus lasts.
Auto-attack enemies between spells so Blighted Quiver stacks up, then use any ability to detonate it for extra damage and shorter cooldowns.
Hold Piercing Arrow a moment before firing when the enemy is far away; a longer charge means more damage and range.
In close fights, release Piercing Arrow quickly instead of waiting for a full charge.
Snipe with Piercing Arrow from far away, or when enemies run, since it has very long range.
You move slower while charging Piercing Arrow, so only charge when no enemy can reach you.
Drop Hail of Arrows on a lane enemy who is trying to escape or walk up to you; it leaves them slowed and cuts their healing.
Aim Chain of Corruption at the enemy you most want to catch. It roots the first champion hit and can spread to nearby enemy champions who stay close.
Use Chain of Corruption to set up a kill: the root also adds Blight stacks, so follow with Piercing Arrow or Hail of Arrows to detonate them.
Take a kill or assist and keep fighting; Living Vengeance boosts Varus for a short time, especially after a champion takedown.
Level Blighted Quiver early to poke enemies and last-hit minions more easily.

combos.name: Ult into Blight detonate
combos.when: When you land the root and want to burst a target, such as in a teamfight or a pick.
combos.text: Chain of Corruption puts max Blight stacks on the rooted target over the root. Fire a charged Piercing Arrow into the root to detonate them for big damage.

tips.text: Charge Piercing Arrow from long range and fire it at Aatrox before he can close in. His short reach means you can poke him freely.
Put Hail of Arrows on the ground where Aatrox wants to fight. It slows him and cuts his healing, which hurts his sustain.
Step sideways or toward Aatrox when Infernal Chains lands so you leave the circle before the pull. Staying inside it drags you back to him.
Don't stand still while his Darkin Blade swings are winding up. The hit zones are easy to see, so walk out of them.
Hold Chain of Corruption until Aatrox commits to a fight. It roots him, and he cannot dash away with Umbral Dash.
Keep Hail of Arrows ready for when Briar leaps in; it slows her and cuts her healing, so she has a harder time sticking to you.
Snipe Briar with a fully charged Piercing Arrow from long range while she is far away and cannot reach you.
Hold Chain of Corruption until Briar is on top of you or has used her leaps. The root stops her from chasing and keeps her in your attacks.
Don't stand still charging Piercing Arrow when Briar is close. Charging slows you, so fire it early or use Hail of Arrows.
Poke Darius with a fully charged Piercing Arrow from long range, before he can walk up to you.
Place Hail of Arrows on the ground in front of you when Darius walks in; it slows him and cuts his healing.
Stay out of Apprehend range. When it is on cooldown, trade freely with your arrows.
Keep your distance while charging Piercing Arrow, because it slows you. Darius can catch you if you stand still near him.
If Darius reaches you, use Chain of Corruption to keep him rooted and stop him from chasing you.
Do not let Darius build up bleeds on you; at level 6 Noxian Guillotine finishes you off when you are low.
Hold Chain of Corruption until Fiora's Riposte is spent; if she parries it, the root is turned against you and you are stunned.
Fire Piercing Arrow from long range while Fiora walks up. She has no ranged way to answer it.
Drop Hail of Arrows where Fiora wants to engage. She is slowed, and her healing is reduced, so her Vital heals are weaker.
Do not charge Piercing Arrow when Fiora is close. Fire it quickly, because you move slowly while charging.
Hit Fiora with Hail of Arrows or Piercing Arrow right after she wastes Riposte, so she cannot answer.
Poke Gangplank with a charged Piercing Arrow from long range before he gets Powder Kegs set up.
Keep Chain of Corruption for when Gangplank uses Remove Scurvy, or he will cleanse the root at once.
Hail of Arrows slows Gangplank and cuts his healing; use it to stop him closing in.
Attack kegs that are placed near you. When an enemy destroys one, it is defused and does no damage.
Poke Garen with Piercing Arrow from far away; charge it fully when he cannot reach you.
Do not let Garen hit you with Decisive Strike; he silences you, so keep distance when he speeds up.
Put Hail of Arrows on the ground where Garen must walk; it slows him, but Decisive Strike can clear that slow.
Root Garen with Chain of Corruption when he commits to you, then back away while he is stuck.
Hitting Garen often keeps Perseverance off, so keep poking him to stop his healing.
Run when your health gets low; Demacian Justice hurts more the less health you have.
Hold Piercing Arrow and release it from long range to poke Jayce before he can leap onto you with To the Skies!.
Drop Hail of Arrows where Jayce is standing when he comes in. It slows him and cuts his healing.
Stay back from Jayce when Thundering Blow is ready. It roots you, hits hard and knocks you away.
Use Chain of Corruption at level 6 when Jayce commits to a jump. He is rooted and takes a lot of damage.
If Jayce drops an Acceleration Gate, a long-range blast is coming. Sidestep it instead of walking straight.
Poke with a charged Piercing Arrow from long range while K'Sante walks up to last-hit; he has no ranged answer to it.
Stay out of Ntofo Strikes range. Two hits from it let him pull and stun you, so keep distance and never let him land the first one.
Put Hail of Arrows on the ground when he closes in; it slows him and cuts his healing.
When K'Sante starts charging Path Maker, step back out of its path. It can't be interrupted, and its stun grows the longer he charges.
Save Chain of Corruption to root him when he commits. It also lets you kill him if he goes All Out and is fragile.
Auto him between abilities to stack Blight, then fire Piercing Arrow to detonate it for extra damage and a shorter cooldown.
Poke Malphite from far away with a fully charged Piercing Arrow. He has no way to reach you from that distance.
Place Hail of Arrows where Malphite wants to walk. It slows him and cuts his healing, so he can't close the gap easily.
Keep your distance from Malphite once he reaches level 6. Unstoppable Force knocks you up, and you can't dodge it with crowd control.
Hit Malphite with basic attacks so Blight stacks build up, then detonate them with Piercing Arrow. This also lowers your ability cooldowns.
Seismic Shard slows you and makes Malphite faster. Don't let him hit you with it while you charge an arrow in range.
Keep your distance from Mordekaiser. Poke with a charged Piercing Arrow from long range, and do not let him reach you.
Lay down Hail of Arrows when Mordekaiser walks up, so he is slowed. It also cuts his healing from Indestructible.
Keep moving when Mordekaiser casts Death's Grasp. The claw lands after a short delay, so step out of the way.
Trade with Mordekaiser early, before he has a large Indestructible shield. Attacks with Blighted Quiver stack Blight for a bigger Piercing Arrow.
Do not stay near Mordekaiser after he hits three attacks or spells. His aura then burns you.
When Mordekaiser reaches level 6, stay away from him. Realm of Death cuts you off from allies, and he wins that fight.
Charge Piercing Arrow from long range and poke Rumble before he can reach you. He has to walk up through it.
Watch Rumble's Heat. When he Overheats he cannot cast spells, so that is the time to trade or fight back.
Place Hail of Arrows where Rumble must walk to reach you. It slows him and cuts his healing.
Do not stand in The Equalizer. Step out of the fire quickly, because it deals heavy damage over time.
Dodge Electro Harpoon when you can; each hit slows you and lowers your Magic Resist, so Rumble's next hits hurt more.
Use Chain of Corruption on Rumble when he dives in. A rooted Rumble cannot easily reach you or escape.
Stay out of Decimating Smash range, because a full charge stuns you for a long time. If you see Sion start to charge, walk out of its path.
Poke Sion with Piercing Arrow from long range, and charge it fully when he cannot reach you.
Do not charge Piercing Arrow while Sion is next to you. You are slowed and cannot dodge.
Save Chain of Corruption for when Sion walks up to you or charges Decimating Smash. The root keeps him in place.
Use Hail of Arrows to slow Sion on his way in. It also cuts his healing.
Do not kill Sion carelessly. Glory in Death brings him back with fast, hard-hitting attacks, so stay away until it ends.
Walk up and hit Teemo to build Blighted Quiver stacks, then follow with Piercing Arrow to burst him.
Charge Piercing Arrow from far away; Teemo has less range than you, so you can hit him without being poisoned.
Do not trade after Blinding Dart hits you; your attacks miss. Back off, or use Hail of Arrows to push him away.
Do not chase Teemo through brush or unwarded ground; he can hide there and mushrooms slow and reveal you.
Use Chain of Corruption at level 6 to root Teemo so he cannot flee, then finish him.
Poke Vayne with Piercing Arrow from long range. She is fragile and has to play carefully once she is hurt.
Don't stand with your back to a wall when Vayne can reach you. Condemn into terrain stuns you and hurts a lot.
Put Hail of Arrows where Vayne wants to stand. She is slowed in it and cannot Tumble in to close the gap easily.
Attack Vayne with Blighted Quiver stacks, then fire Piercing Arrow. It sets off the Blight for extra damage and a shorter cooldown.
Hit Vayne with Chain of Corruption when she dives in. Rooted, she cannot Tumble away and her short range makes her easy to kill.
Keep Hail of Arrows for when Yone steps up to trade; it slows him and cuts his healing, so he can't close on you or sustain through the lane.
Poke Yone with fully charged Piercing Arrow from long range, where his short-range Mortal Steel can't answer.
Stay clear of Yone when Fate Sealed is ready. It stuns you and pulls you to him, so keep your distance after level 6.
Land Chain of Corruption on Yone when he dashes in. He is rooted and can't dash away or fight back well, so your follow-up attacks hit.
Don't stand still while charging Piercing Arrow near Yone. Charging slows you, and his Mortal Steel dash can knock you up.
Poke Ashe with Piercing Arrow from far away; she has few ways to escape or dodge a charged shot.
Place Hail of Arrows on Ashe when she backs away; it slows her so she cannot kite you easily.
Respect Ashe's Volley when you walk up; stay behind minions so they absorb the arrows.
Stay near your team while Ashe's Enchanted Crystal Arrow is ready; a stun from far away leaves you open to a gank.
Land Chain of Corruption on Ashe when she is out of position; she has little to get free.
Caitlyn outranges you. Charge Piercing Arrow out of her reach and fire it at her when she steps up to poke or last-hit.
Step around the Yordle Snap Trap spots she places, especially in bushes and on your approach. Getting rooted lets her land a big Headshot.
Use Hail of Arrows on the ground where she stands to slow her and cut her healing, then trade with Blighted Quiver attacks.
Stay behind minions when she fires Piltover Peacemaker; it hits less hard after the first target.
Expect Caitlyn's net to slow you when you walk up, so keep your distance after she uses it.
Look for a Chain of Corruption on Caitlyn at level 6 when she is out of position; it roots her for a kill.
Hit Ezreal with attacks from Blighted Quiver, then fire Piercing Arrow to burst the stacks. It is a strong trade against a fragile target.
Charge Piercing Arrow behind your minions. Ezreal's Mystic Shot stops at the first unit it hits, so it can't reach you through them.
Throw Hail of Arrows where Ezreal will blink or walk. It slows him and makes his escapes harder.
Hold Chain of Corruption until Arcane Shift is used. Otherwise Ezreal can blink away from the shot.
Charge Piercing Arrow from outside Jhin's attack range; its very long range lets you hit him before he can shoot back.
Put Hail of Arrows on Jhin when he steps up to last-hit; the slowed area makes him easy to follow up on.
Jhin cannot attack while he reloads after his fourth shot. Step in and trade then.
Watch for Jhin's invisible traps from Captive Audience before you walk into bushes or chase him.
Stay out of Jhin's line when you are hurt or a teammate has just hit you. Deadly Flourish can root you.
Hit Jhin with a few basic attacks first, then fire Piercing Arrow so Blighted Quiver stacks go off for extra damage.
Charge Piercing Arrow from outside her range and release it when she steps up to last-hit. Its very long range lets you poke her first.
Land an auto attack before Hail of Arrows so Blight stacks go off for extra damage. Her slowed, healing-cut body is easy to chase.
Aim Chain of Corruption at Jinx when you can hit her. If she is rooted, she cannot get away from you.
Jump on Jinx when she pokes with rockets, before her minigun ramps up. She is weakest then.
Don't charge Piercing Arrow where Jinx can line up Zap!
Charge Piercing Arrow from behind your minions and fire it from long range. Kai'Sa has to walk up to hit you.
Use Hail of Arrows when Kai'Sa walks up to trade. It slows her and cuts her healing.
Auto Kai'Sa to build Blight, then detonate it with Piercing Arrow or Hail of Arrows. That deals extra damage and shortens your cooldowns.
Save Chain of Corruption for when Kai'Sa dashes in with Killer Instinct. Root her to punish her and protect yourself.
You can't charge Piercing Arrow and cast Hail of Arrows at once. Don't start a long charge when Kai'Sa is already close.
Charge Piercing Arrow from far away and fire it when Miss Fortune lines up with her minions or walks forward.
Hit Miss Fortune to cancel her speed boost from Strut; then she is easier to catch.
Trade with attacks first so Blight stacks build, then follow with Hail of Arrows for extra damage.
Stay out of Make It Rain; being slowed in it lets Miss Fortune hit you with follow-up shots.
Step out of Miss Fortune's line when Bullet Time begins; run out of the cone instead of standing in it.
Keep minions out of line with Miss Fortune and you; Double Up bounces to a champion behind its first target.
Hit Smolder with Hail of Arrows early; he is weak before he has stacks, so make him back off and miss last hits.
Snipe with a fully charged Piercing Arrow from long range; Smolder has to walk up to cast Super Scorcher Breath.
Auto Smolder to build Blight, then detonate it with an ability to trade and shorten your cooldowns.
Land Chain of Corruption on Smolder when his team is far away; he is rooted and can't fly out with Flap, Flap, Flap.
Stay out of a straight line from Smolder; Achooo! travels very far and slows you.
Charge Piercing Arrow from long range while Yunara is last-hitting; her slow only matters once you are close, so poke her before she can reach you.
Hold Chain of Corruption for when Yunara has used her dash; rooting her then leaves her stuck in your team's damage.
Put Hail of Arrows on Yunara when she walks up to trade. She is slowed and healing less, so her all-in is weaker.
Do not stand in a straight line with Yunara while charging Piercing Arrow. Her slowing bead leaves you crawling and you will be hit.
